icraft.origin.archmage.description: A master of arcane power, fragile as glass and twice as sharp. Archmages command great magical force at the cost of nearly all physical resilience: less health, halved equipment health, a thin frame and half the melee damage. Their spells grow stronger with every tier of world they reach, and their mana pool runs at 2.5x the baseline, enough for long barrages.
icraft.origin.archmage.name: Archmage
icraft.origin.artificer.description: Master of craft and industry. Artificers mine and swing faster, and a crafting table nearby quickens their step. They carry no health penalty; their strength comes from the workshop they build.
icraft.origin.artificer.name: Artificer
icraft.origin.artificial_construct.descr: An iron golem given life. Food gives 25% nourishment; eat iron for Regen III instead. Five upgrade tiers from iron consumption (5/5/5/10/10%, max +35%). Extended reach, natural armor, reduced fall damage.
icraft.origin.artificial_construct.name: Artificial Construct
icraft.origin.battlemage.description: Where sword meets sorcery. Battlemages deal 10% bonus melee damage and 15% bonus magic damage, and their Mana Shield keeps them standing (stronger still for a Faefolk). Stack spell power and every swing hits harder. Their mana pool runs at 1.9x the baseline.
icraft.origin.battlemage.name: Battlemage
icraft.origin.berserker.description: A whirlwind of steel and fury. Berserkers deal 15% bonus damage with axes, at the cost of ranged and magical finesse. The closer they are to death, the harder they hit, and a long fight makes them stronger still.
icraft.origin.berserker.name: Berserker
icraft.origin.demi_god.description: Scion of a forgotten god, the Demi-God towers over mortal limits with +40% health and the power to phase through matter. Divine Fury grants Strength on command. Raw meat nourishes them twice as much as usual, cooked meat one and a half times as much. Fire burns them 50% hotter, and the Nether sickens their divine blood, though they can fight through it.
icraft.origin.demi_god.name: Demi-God
icraft.origin.dwarf.description: Stout and unyielding, Dwarves were born for the deep places of the world. They mine 15% faster, shrug off fire, and their dense frames absorb punishment. Slow and earthbound, they trade agility for endurance, and they barely break a sweat at the forge.
icraft.origin.dwarf.name: Dwarf
icraft.origin.elf.description: Graceful and keen-eyed, Elves see perfectly in darkness and are quick on their feet. Their arrows strike 15% harder, and their attunement to magic strengthens their spells. Slender frames make them fragile, and a high metabolism means they need to eat more often.
icraft.origin.elf.name: Elf
icraft.origin.faefolk.description: Swift and magical, Faefolk drift on the wind and channel 30% more power through their spells. +10% speed and +10% mana regen, but -15% HP and -30% melee damage. Your fae body rejects heavy plating: medium or heavy armor grants only half its toughness. Full robes (4 light pieces) avoid this. Fight in robes and let your spells do the work.
icraft.origin.faefolk.name: Faefolk
icraft.origin.fallen_angel.description: A celestial being cast from grace, frail but deadly. All attacks deal 15% bonus damage, though their broken body holds 20% less health. Tattered wings slow their descent, and they crave meat to fuel their war against creation. Fire sears them deeper than most.
icraft.origin.fallen_angel.name: Fallen Angel
icraft.origin.halfling.description: Small but lucky, Halflings find better loot and stretch every meal 20% further. They lack raw strength and make up for it with uncanny luck and an appetite that never seems to bottom out.
icraft.origin.halfling.name: Halfling
icraft.origin.human.description: Versatile and quick to learn, Humans gain 10% more experience from everything they do. Beyond that they have no innate strengths or weaknesses, and they adapt to whatever path they choose.
icraft.origin.human.name: Human
icraft.origin.kirin.description: A mythical beast built for speed. Kirin scale walls like spiders, see in the dark, and sprint faster than any other race. Their lithe frames hold 20% less health, and all that running burns through food quickly.
icraft.origin.kirin.name: Kirin
icraft.origin.orc.description: Brutal and relentless. Orcs hit harder, swing faster, and take more punishment, but they burn through food at an alarming rate. The hungrier they get, the more dangerous they become.
icraft.origin.orc.name: Orc
icraft.origin.paladin.description: A holy warrior who protects the faithful. Paladins are heavily armored and hard to move, and their healing aura mends nearby allies. Potions, golden apples and healing spells mend them 25% more.
icraft.origin.paladin.name: Paladin
icraft.origin.ranger.description: Fleet of foot and deadly at range. Rangers trade durability for speed and heavy projectile damage. Their light frames and fragile gear make every hit they take count, and they are at their best landing a shot before the enemy closes the gap.
icraft.origin.ranger.name: Ranger
icraft.origin.revenant.description: Risen from death's grip, Revenants thrive in shadow: in darkness and the Abyss they hit 20% harder in melee and take 20% less damage. Sunlight saps their strength with Weakness and Slowness. Their undead bodies draw less nourishment from food, but darkness is all the sustenance they need.
icraft.origin.revenant.name: Undead (Revenant)
icraft.origin.ryu.description: Dragon-blooded and ancient, the Ryu shrugs off 25% of all damage and heals rapidly from hearty meals. Broken wings grant slow fall rather than true flight. Their draconic stomach rejects anything that isn't meat, and healing potions are only half as potent on their scaled hide.
icraft.origin.ryu.name: Ryu
icraft.origin.samurai.description: Disciplined and precise, the Samurai strikes to kill. Swift on their feet and deadly against unwounded foes, they are masters of the killing blow. Patience pays: a moment of stillness before the strike makes it hit much harder.
icraft.origin.samurai.name: Samurai
icraft.origin.slimebodied.description: An amorphous being of living gel. Food provides only 5% nourishment, but hunger drains at 25% of the normal rate and never while idle. Well-fed slimes gain up to 25% damage reduction. 10-second cooldown between meals. 75% base health, -50% armor toughness. Satiety never drops below 25%. Invest in high-quality food.
icraft.origin.slimebodied.name: Slimebodied
icraft.origin.vanguard.description: The immovable object. Vanguards take punishment that would fell other classes, with high health, armor, and knockback resistance, and their presence alone weakens nearby enemies. In return they deal 30% less melee damage and leave the killing to their allies.
icraft.origin.vanguard.name: Vanguard
icraft.origin.void_summoner.description: A puppet master who commands from the shadows. A Void Summoner's tamed beasts and summoned servants strike harder, every death nearby feeds a little life and experience back to their master, and in darkness the Summoner strikes harder too. Their mana pool runs at 1.9x the baseline.
icraft.origin.void_summoner.name: Void Summoner
icraft.origin.wanderer.description: A jack of all trades and master of none, but still better than a master of one. Wanderers gain modest bonuses to everything and learn faster than anyone. Switching weapon types in combat gives them even more damage.
icraft.origin.wanderer.name: Wanderer
icraft.origin.witch_of_ink.description: A living canvas of ink and will. Half food, -20% HP, fire weakness. Boss kills scale damage dealt and incoming damage reduction (max 200). At 200: Blessing of Penthesilea grants bonus HP, Resistance, and Haste.
icraft.origin.witch_of_ink.name: Witch of Ink
icraft.origin.witherborn.description: Born of decay, the Witherborn wields the Wither itself as a weapon. Melee attacks inflict Wither on targets, even bosses that are normally immune. Hunger saps their strength: up to -50% damage when starving. Food provides only 25% nourishment, and hunger drains 50% faster. Keep eating or wither away.
icraft.origin.witherborn.name: Witherborn
-50% melee damage. Mages weren't built to swing axes.
-28.6% armor, -20% armor toughness. A full robe set nets ~50% armor.
Significantly reduced max HP (-20%). Equipment HP halved.
icraft.power.class.archmage.mana_attunem: +5% spell power for each passive tier above the first: +0% at Tier 1, +5% at Tier 2, +10% at Tier 3, +15% at Tier 4. Your passive tier is the highest tier of dimension you have entered, and it never goes down.
icraft.power.class.archmage.mana_pool.de: +150% max mana: your pool runs at 2.5x the baseline, 250 instead of 100.
icraft.power.class.artificer.resourceful: A crafting table within 4 blocks gives you Speed I (+20% movement speed).
+90% max mana: your pool runs at 1.9x the baseline, 190 instead of 100.
icraft.power.class.battlemage.mana_shiel: Resistance I at all times (Resistance II for a Faefolk Battlemage). Melee kills restore 15 mana.
icraft.power.class.berserker.battle_tran: After 10 seconds of landing hits, gain +5% melee damage and +1 armor. Lost after 5 seconds without landing a hit.
Below 40% HP: +20% melee damage. Below 20%: +40% damage.
icraft.power.class.berserker.blood_fury_: Below 20% HP: an additional +20% melee damage on top of the standard Blood Fury bonus, totaling +40%.
icraft.power.class.berserker.brutal_stri: Berserkers despise the bow. -40% damage with bow/crossbow.
Berserkers despise the wand. -30% damage when wielding a spell book or magic catalyst.
icraft.power.class.berserker.weapon_affi: +15% damage with axes. Berserkers despise the bow (-40%) and the wand (-30%).
Allies within 8 blocks slowly regenerate HP (0.5 HP/5s). The Paladin regenerates 1 HP/5s when above 50% HP.
icraft.power.class.paladin.holy_armor.de: +3 armor, +1 armor toughness from divine blessing.
icraft.power.class.ranger.eagle_eye.name: Eagle Eye
icraft.power.class.ranger.hp_modifier.de: Significantly reduced max HP (-20%). Equipment HP halved.
icraft.power.class.ranger.swift.name: Swift
icraft.power.class.samurai.bushido.descr: +15% damage against full-HP enemies. Kills within 3 seconds of first strike grant a speed boost.
icraft.power.class.samurai.bushido.name: Bushido
icraft.power.class.samurai.focus.descrip: Not attacking for 3 seconds grants 'Focused': next attack deals +30% damage with +20% crit chance.
icraft.power.class.samurai.focus.name: Focus
icraft.power.class.vanguard.damage_penal: -30% melee damage dealt. The Vanguard holds the line and leaves the killing to others.
icraft.power.class.vanguard.guardian.des: Mobs within 5 blocks of you get Weakness I, so their melee hits deal 4 less damage.
icraft.power.class.void_summoner.dark_pa: +15% damage dealt by your tamed animals and your Iron's Spells summons.
icraft.power.class.void_summoner.expande: Mana pool runs at ~1.9x the baseline, enough to keep casting from the shadows.
icraft.power.class.void_summoner.hp_modi: Reduced max HP (-10%). Equipment HP halved.
icraft.power.class.void_summoner.mana_po: +90% max mana: your pool runs at 1.9x the baseline, 190 instead of 100.
icraft.power.class.void_summoner.shadow_: +10% melee damage in darkness (light level 9 or lower). No penalty in light.
icraft.power.class.void_summoner.soul_te: Whenever a creature dies within 16 blocks of you, by any hand, you heal 5% of its max health (up to 1 heart) and gain 1 XP.
icraft.power.class.wanderer.adaptable.de: Using 3+ different weapon types within 60 seconds grants +10% damage for 30 seconds.
icraft.power.class.wanderer.jack_of_all_: +5% attack damage, +5% movement speed, +5% attack speed.
icraft.power.origin.artificial_construct: Natural armor and a metallic sheen.
Normal food provides only 25% nourishment. Your construct body processes it inefficiently. Iron ingots and blocks are your true fuel.
icraft.power.origin.demi_god.cursed.desc: The Nether's corruption weakens you slightly, but you can still fight through it.
icraft.power.origin.demi_god.cursed.name: Nether Unease
icraft.power.origin.demi_god.fire.descri: Your divine flesh burns more easily. You take 50% more fire damage.
icraft.power.origin.demi_god.fire.name: Fire Sensitivity
icraft.power.origin.demi_god.health.desc: +40% max HP from your divine blood.
icraft.power.origin.demi_god.health.name: Divine Constitution
icraft.power.origin.demi_god.raw_meat_bu: Raw meat provides double nourishment. Cooked meat-based foods provide 50% more.
icraft.power.origin.fallen_angel.bloodth: Permanent Strength I. Your fallen nature demands violence.
icraft.power.origin.fallen_angel.fire.de: Fire burns deeper against your fallen form.
icraft.power.origin.fallen_angel.fragile: -20% max HP. Your mortal frame is frail.
icraft.power.origin.fallen_angel.immunit: Immune to Wither, Poison, Instant Damage, and Nausea.
icraft.power.origin.fallen_angel.roof.de: Slower under roofs. The memory of confinement haunts you.
icraft.power.origin.fallen_angel.velocit: Launch yourself forward, leaving a withering cloud.
icraft.power.origin.kirin.climb.descript: Scale walls like a spider. Toggle with save toolbar key.
icraft.power.origin.kirin.climb.name: Wall Climber
icraft.power.origin.kirin.dislike_of_wat: Water slows you and saps your strength.
icraft.power.origin.kirin.exhaustion.des: Your speed burns through food quickly.
icraft.power.origin.kirin.jump_boost.des: Launch forward with a burst of speed. 25s cooldown.
icraft.power.origin.kirin.unrivaled_spee: Burst of Speed II for 12 seconds. 60s cooldown.
icraft.power.origin.ryu.all_knowing.desc: Reveal all nearby entities with Glowing. 15s cooldown.
icraft.power.origin.ryu.all_knowing.name: Dragon's Sight
Your dragon blood resists magical healing. Healing potions are 50% as effective.
icraft.power.origin.ryu.natural_protecti: +4 max HP from thick dragon scales.
icraft.power.origin.ryu.so_much_weight.d: Your draconic heritage grants 25% damage reduction from all sources.
icraft.power.origin.slimebodied.food_coo: 10-second cooldown between eating. Your body needs time to absorb each meal.
icraft.power.origin.slimebodied.food_eff: Food provides only 5% nourishment. Your amorphous body absorbs almost nothing. Eat high-quality meals.
icraft.power.origin.slimebodied.reduced_: 75% base health. Your gelatinous body has less structural integrity.
-50% armor toughness. Armor sits loosely on your shifting form.
icraft.power.origin.slimebodied.satiety_: Gain up to 25% damage reduction based on satiation. A well-fed slime is a tough slime.
Satiety cannot drop below 25%. Your core always retains some sustenance.
icraft.power.origin.slimebodied.slow_met: Hunger drains at 25% of the normal rate and does not drain while idle. Your body conserves energy efficiently.
icraft.power.origin.witch_of_ink.fired.d: Fire burns hotter against your ink-stained body.
icraft.power.origin.witch_of_ink.frail.d: Your body is made of ink and parchment. -20% max HP.
Food provides 50% less nourishment. Your body of ink prefers to feed on art.
icraft.power.origin.witherborn.attack_sp: +15% attack speed. The Witherborn attacks with frantic, decaying energy.
icraft.power.origin.witherborn.food_effi: Food provides only 25% nourishment. Your decaying body barely processes sustenance.
icraft.power.origin.witherborn.hunger_dr: Hunger drains 50% faster. Your body consumes itself.
icraft.power.origin.witherborn.hunger_we: Lose up to 50% damage as hunger increases. The emptier your stomach, the weaker your strikes.
icraft.power.origin.witherborn.wither_im: Immune to the Wither effect. The decay flows through you harmlessly.
icraft.power.origin.witherborn.wither_to: Melee attacks apply Wither to targets. Bosses normally immune to Wither receive True Wither instead.
icraft.power.race.dwarf.fire_resist.desc: 50% fire resistance: take half damage from fire sources.
icraft.power.race.dwarf.fire_resist.name: Forge-Hardened
icraft.power.race.dwarf.miner_appetite.d: Hunger consumption while mining is halved. Your dwarven constitution is built for underground work.
icraft.power.race.dwarf.slow.name: Short Legs
icraft.power.race.dwarf.sturdy.name: Sturdy Build
icraft.power.race.elf.fragile.name: Fragile Frame
icraft.power.race.elf.night_vision.name: Darkvision
icraft.power.race.elf.ranged_bonus.name: Eagle Eye
icraft.power.race.elf.swift.name: Elven Grace
icraft.power.race.faefolk.fragile.descri: -15% max HP. Your ethereal form is delicate.
icraft.power.race.faefolk.fragile.name: Fae Fragility
icraft.power.race.faefolk.nature_magic.d: +30% magic damage and +10% mana regen, from the fae attunement to natural energy.
icraft.power.race.faefolk.armor_weakness: -50% armor toughness while wearing any medium or heavy armor. Your fae body rejects heavy plating; full robes (4 light pieces) avoid this penalty entirely.
-30% melee damage. Your delicate fae body is unsuited to brute force; let your magic do the killing.
icraft.power.race.faefolk.slow_fall.desc: Drift gently on the wind. No fall damage.
icraft.power.race.faefolk.slow_fall.name: Fae Wings
icraft.power.race.faefolk.swift.descript: +10% movement speed. Light on your feet.
icraft.power.race.faefolk.swift.name: Fae Swiftness
icraft.power.race.halfling.food_efficien: +20% food and saturation from all foods.
icraft.power.race.halfling.lucky.name: Fortune's Favor
icraft.power.race.human.versatile.descri: No special abilities, no weaknesses. Pairs well with any class.
icraft.power.race.human.versatile.name: Versatile
icraft.power.race.human.xp_bonus.name: Quick Learner
icraft.power.race.orc.attack_speed.descr: +10% attack speed. Orcs swing fast and hard.
icraft.power.race.orc.attack_speed.name: Battle Fury
icraft.power.race.orc.health_bonus.name: Orcish Endurance
icraft.power.race.orc.hunger_drain.descr: +50% hunger drain. The fury burns through food.
icraft.power.race.orc.hunger_drain.name: Ravenous
icraft.power.race.orc.hunger_fury.descri: Gain up to +20% bonus damage as hunger increases. The hungrier you are, the harder you hit.
icraft.power.race.orc.hunger_fury.name: Bloodlust
icraft.power.race.orc.melee_bonus.name: Orcish Strength
icraft.power.race.revenant.dark_power.de: +20% melee damage in darkness and in The Abyss, and 20% less damage taken in deep darkness (light level 4 or lower) and in The Abyss.
icraft.power.race.revenant.healing_penal: -20% nourishment from food. Your undead body struggles to process sustenance.
icraft.power.race.revenant.sunlight_weak: Sunlight causes Weakness and Slowness. Wear a helmet or stay in shade.
icraft.power.race.ryu.food_healing.descr: When well-fed, you heal rapidly from hearty meals.
icraft.power.race.ryu.food_healing.name: Draconic Vitality
icraft.power.race.ryu.slow_fall.descript: Broken wings grant slow fall rather than true flight.
icraft.power.race.ryu.slow_fall.name: Broken Wings
icraft.origin.elemental.name: Elemental (Stormcaller)
icraft.origin.elemental.description: A triad specialist of fire, ice, and lightning, built as a glass-cannon artillery mage. +80% spell power in all three elemental schools, and nothing in the other six. Resists holy and nature magic; vulnerable to blood. Its HP is tied with the Archmage's for the lowest of any caster, and its equipment HP is halved too: the highest-burst mage in the pack. It out-damages the Archmage on its three schools and is far weaker than the Archmage everywhere else.
icraft.origin.blessed.name: Blessed (Hierophant)
icraft.origin.blessed.description: A triad specialist of holy, nature, and evocation, built as a sustain and support crusader. +80% spell power in all three blessed schools. Strong blood and ender resistance lets it outlast the Corrupted; vulnerable to fire. Hardier than other casters (+10% HP, no equipment halving) and the best healer in the pack. It out-heals and outlasts the Archmage on its schools, with weaker raw burst elsewhere.
icraft.origin.corrupted.name: Corrupted (Hollow)
icraft.origin.corrupted.description: A triad specialist of blood, ender, and eldritch, built to wear enemies down and drain them. +80% spell power in all three corrupted schools, plus lifesteal. Resists the elemental triad (fire/ice/lightning) to survive the opening burst, then drains the damage back; vulnerable to holy. It outlasts the Archmage in a long fight on its schools and loses to a Blessed mage's smite.
icraft.power.class.elemental.hp_modifier: Significantly reduced max HP (-20%). Equipment HP halved.
icraft.power.class.elemental.triad_attun: +80% fire, ice, and lightning spell power. Nothing for the other six schools.
icraft.power.class.elemental.school_affi: +30% holy resist, +20% nature resist. -25% blood resist (vulnerable to the Corrupted).
icraft.power.class.elemental.mana_pool.d: Mana pool runs at 2x baseline (+100% max mana).
icraft.power.class.blessed.hp_modifier.d: Increased max HP (+10%). Hardier than other casters.
icraft.power.class.blessed.triad_attunem: +80% holy, nature, and evocation spell power. Nothing for the other six schools.
icraft.power.class.blessed.school_affini: +35% blood resist, +25% ender resist (smite the Corrupted). -20% fire resist (vulnerable to the Elemental).
icraft.power.class.blessed.mana_pool.des: Mana pool runs at 2x baseline (+100% max mana).
icraft.power.class.corrupted.hp_modifier: Reduced max HP (-10%). Relies on lifesteal to stay alive.
icraft.power.class.corrupted.triad_attun: +80% blood, ender, and eldritch spell power. Nothing for the other six schools.
icraft.power.class.corrupted.school_affi: +30% fire, ice, and lightning resist (survive the Elemental's burst, then drain it). -30% holy resist (vulnerable to the Blessed).
icraft.power.class.corrupted.mana_pool.d: Mana pool runs at 2x baseline (+100% max mana).
